248.credits: Made by SeventhDread for Open Historia. Based on [GOT-Inspired-Map](https://github.com/mapbox/GOT-Inspired-Map) (A Song of Ice and Fire speculative world map): GIS files by cadaei, based on maps by Tear and theMountainGoat. A Song of Ice and Fire, and every place on this map, are (c) George R. R. Martin. Changed from the original: drawn as a relief map and cut into map tiles, with extra detail added around Winterfell, King's Landing and Dragonstone. 248.changes: Adds Lonely Light, the westernmost of the Iron Islands, which version 1 left out: a bare rock with a few skerries and House Farwynd's keep with its beacon tower. The rest of the map is exactly the same as version 1.
